pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit a polygonal geometry with soft-to-moderately sharp edge gradients. Patch area is larger and more elongated on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed shapes as they approach the dorsal ridge.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the dark patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-directional. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank with slight narrowing at the vertices of patch intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration is visible along the mane of the upper neck, creating a fine-grained jagged silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A vertical cluster of three distinct, small, dark circular nodules or textural disruptions is visible on the lower-mid flank area.
